_conventions.bands: [operator, value, score]; evaluated top-down, first match wins, else 'else' score. Operators: > >= < <= == in
_conventions.categorical: map of bucket -> score; bucket names are produced by derived_metrics
_conventions.penalty_kind: criteria with kind=penalty carry min (negative) and add 0 to module max; module score floors at 0
_conventions.missing_data: CORRECTED IN v1.5: a criterion whose metric is UNKNOWN is NOT scored zero. It is unavailable, contributes to the score range [0, max], and reduces point-weighted completeness. A criterion whose metric is NOT_APPLICABLE is removed from both numerator and denominator.
_conventions.knockout_logic: Kleene three-valued logic. A leaf referencing an UNKNOWN metric/flag resolves to UNKNOWN. 'any' is TRIGGERED if any child is TRUE, else UNVERIFIED if any child is UNKNOWN, else CLEAR. 'all' is TRIGGERED if all children TRUE, else CLEAR if any child is FALSE, else UNVERIFIED. A missing input must never yield CLEAR.
_conventions.unknown_is_not_zero: No derived metric may substitute 0, a favourable default, or a legal maximum for an UNKNOWN input. Derived metrics propagate UNKNOWN.

post_listing_1w.description: Lifecycle stage after listing: the frozen inputs plus the 1-week realised outcome. Scoring is unchanged; the outcome is recorded for back-testing (spec s21).

post_listing_1m.description: Lifecycle stage after listing: the frozen inputs plus the 1-month realised outcome (spec s21).

post_listing_6m.description: Lifecycle stage after listing: the frozen inputs plus the 6-month realised outcome (spec s21).

criteria.label: Cash flow quality (cumulative CFO / cumulative PAT)
Board independence & KMP stability
criteria.note: 'other' = 1 fills a gap; the specification defines only 2 and 0

add.label: CRAR / Tier 1 buffer over regulatory minimum (pts)
CFO/PAT with order-book or pre-sales exemption
add.note: exempt score of 3 is an interpretation of 'negative CFO accepted'; calibrate

add.label: Net debt/equity trend and project-debt interest cover

loss_making.note: margin_trend removed so each underlying metric is scored once: operating loss trend (A), contribution margin (A), cash runway (A); P/S carries the full 12 valuation points formerly split with PEG

retail_heavy.note: QIB portion <=10% of the offer: no anchor book and QIB subscription carries no signal, so both items are replaced

knockouts.label: Qualified/adverse/disclaimer opinion, going concern, or negative net worth
Promoter pledge >25% or active SEBI/ED action
Promoters + PE/VC sell >50% of combined holding, promoters exit/<20%, and weak financials
Contingent liabilities >50% of net worth (or unquantified)
Related parties drive >40% of revenue growth

items.label: Margin up >500 bps YoY in either of the last two FYs
Heavy non-pro-rata discounted allotments/ESOPs within 18 months before DRHP (pro-rata bonus/rights excluded)
Adjusted metrics with no Ind AS reconciliation

confidence.note: CORRECTED IN v1.5: completeness is weighted by evaluable scoring POINTS, not by the count of populated criteria. Penalty criteria (max 0) are excluded from the positive-point denominator.

critical_data.description: Inputs whose absence makes a normal verdict unsafe. If any is UNKNOWN and no knockout is TRIGGERED, the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than a score-derived band.

gcp.policy: CORRECTED IN v1.5: when the RHP shows GCP as [●] the amount is UNKNOWN. The legal maximum (25% of the Fresh Offer, SEBI ICDR Reg. 7(2)) is recorded separately as a limit and MUST NOT be substituted for the actual amount. Criteria whose bands depend on the GCP amount become UNKNOWN and contribute to the score range.
gcp.legal_max_source: SEBI ICDR Regulations, Regulation 7(2); RHP Objects of the Offer

pat_latest.formula: PAT of latest restated full FY (INR_CRORES)

net_worth_latest.formula: net worth of latest restated full FY (INR_CRORES)

revenue_cagr_2y_from_3fy.formula: ((revenue[latest] / revenue[latest-2]) ^ (1/2) - 1) * 100; requires 3 full FY observations. Renamed from the misleading 'revenue_cagr_3y'.

revenue_cagr_3y_from_4fy.formula: ((revenue[latest] / revenue[latest-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1) * 100; reported only when 4 full FY observations exist. Not scored.

margin_trend.formula: expanding: EBITDA and PAT margin both up each year; declining_or_loss: latest PAT<=0 or both margins down; volatile: direction flips with range >300 bps; else stable. UNKNOWN if any required margin is UNKNOWN.

margin_trend_5y_avg.formula: cyclical override: margin_trend computed on 5-FY average margins

roce_latest.formula: EBIT / (total equity + total borrowings), latest FY, %. Per RHP 'Basis for Offer Price' definitions: EBIT = restated PAT + total tax expense + finance costs, less exceptional items; Capital Employed = total equity + total borrowings. A disclosed ROCE in the RHP overrides the computed value and is marked VERIFIED with its page reference.

cfo_pat_cumulative.formula: sum(CFO over available full FY observations) / sum(PAT over the same observations). This is a cumulative ratio, NOT the arithmetic average of yearly CFO/PAT ratios. UNKNOWN if any required CFO/PAT is UNKNOWN or if sum(PAT) <= 0.

leverage_bucket.formula: strong: D/E<0.5 and ICR>5; ok: D/E<1; stretched: 1<=D/E<=2; weak: D/E>2. UNKNOWN if D/E is UNKNOWN. ICR is UNKNOWN when interest expense is UNKNOWN or zero; it is never substituted with a favourable sentinel.

pe_premium_pct.formula: (issue price / post-issue EPS) / peer median P/E - 1, x100; positive = premium. UNKNOWN if the peer snapshot is not VALID (stale/unusable/missing peers cannot silently score).

second_multiple_premium_pct.formula: same construction on EV/EBITDA; P/B if EBITDA is not meaningful. UNKNOWN if the peer snapshot is not VALID.

pb_roe_adjusted_premium_pct.formula: issuer P/B divided by the ROE-adjusted peer median P/B - 1, x100

peg.formula: post-issue P/E / PAT CAGR (2Y from 3 FY), %; UNKNOWN if CAGR<=0 or P/E UNKNOWN

low_base_year.formula: earliest-year PAT margin < low_base_margin_ratio x latest-year margin

sector_ipo_relative.formula: post-issue P/E vs median of last 4 same-sector IPOs: cheaper < -sector_ipo_band_pct; richer > +band; else in_line. UNKNOWN when no recent sector IPOs are supplied.

ofs_seller_bucket.formula: promoter_selling if any promoter or promoter_group seller sold >0; else pe_vc_exit if any PE/VC sells >=25% of its holding; else none_or_small

promoter_ofs_pct_of_holding.formula: promoter shares sold / sum(pre_issue_shares of promoter & promoter_group sellers) x 100. Denominator is the listed selling shareholders' own pre-issue shares (as defined by the input schema for ofs_sellers); UNKNOWN when no promoter seller is listed and the OFS composition cannot be established.

pe_promoter_sold_pct_combined.formula: (promoter + PE/VC shares sold) / (their listed pre-issue shares) x 100

use_of_proceeds_bucket.formula: blind_heavy: (gcp + unidentified acquisition)/fresh > 20%; else debt_heavy: debt repayment/fresh > 50%; else growth: (capex + R&D)/fresh >= growth_share_min_pct; else mixed_ok. v1.5: if the GCP amount is UNKNOWN the bucket is UNKNOWN because the blind_heavy test cannot be evaluated; the legal maximum is NOT substituted.

pre_ipo_placement_bucket.formula: deep_discount_12m: any placement in 12M before issue open at >25% below issue price; none_or_near_ipo: none, or all within near_ipo_price_pct of issue price; else in_between

lockin_bucket.formula: intact: promoter lock-in in place and no early unlock of large pre-IPO holders; else weak

rpt_pct_of_revenue_growth.formula: share of revenue growth attributable to related parties, %

auditor_bucket.formula: clean_reputed: reputed firm, unqualified, no change, no EOM; eom_only: Emphasis of Matter/CARO/disputed tax only; unstable_or_repeated_eom: auditor change in 3Y or repeated EoM. The auditor-change count and repeated-EOM inputs are separate. UNKNOWN when the opinion is not supplied. A qualified/adverse/disclaimer opinion is a knockout, not a bucket.

eom_materiality.formula: low / medium / high by size of matter relative to net worth

board_kmp_bucket.formula: independent_stable: independent-majority board, no KMP exit in 2Y; high_churn: >=2 KMP exits in 2Y; else other

industry_cagr_pct.formula: forward industry CAGR from the independent industry report in the RHP, %. Requires scope, forecast period and source to be complete.

top5_concentration_pct.formula: the higher of top-5 customer and top-5 supplier concentration (%). UNKNOWN if neither is supplied.

market_regime_variant.formula: hot if >= min_count of last lookback_ipos listed above listing_gain_pct; else normal

retail_or_nii_below_1x.formula: retail or NII subscription < 1.0x at close. UNKNOWN unless both are supplied.

profit_declining.formula: PAT down YoY in latest FY, or PAT CAGR (2Y from 3 FY) < 0

margin_spike_pre_ipo.formula: EBITDA margin rise exceeds margin_spike_bps in either of the last two FYs

cfo_exempt.formula: cfo_pat_cumulative < 0 and (order book >= 2x revenue (EPC) or collections >= pre-sales trend (real estate)) and receivable days YoY < 15%

crar_buffer_pts.formula: CRAR (or Tier 1) minus the regulatory minimum, percentage points

cash_runway_months.formula: (post-issue cash and equivalents) / (average monthly operating cash burn, latest FY). UNKNOWN when the latest FY was not cash-consumptive or when cash/burn inputs are UNKNOWN; never a favourable sentinel.

contribution_bucket.formula: expanding_2y_gt300bps: positive and up >300 bps YoY two years running; positive_improving; positive_flat_or_falling; negative

loss_narrowing_bucket.formula: two_years: operating loss % of revenue narrowed 2 consecutive years; one_year: latest year only; widening: otherwise

nim_cost_income_bucket.formula: trend of NIM and cost-to-income across the FY observations

roa_roe_peer_quartile.formula: ROA/ROE of the issuer vs the peer snapshot quartiles

net_debt_bucket.formula: net debt/equity trend and project-debt interest cover

pe_premium_mid_cycle_pct.formula: pe_premium_pct computed on mid-cycle (5-FY average) EPS

ps_premium_pct.formula: market cap / revenue vs peer median P/S

qib_quota_pct.formula: QIB share of the offer, % (issue.quota_pct.qib); <=10 triggers the retail_heavy structure overlay

gcp_amount.formula: the disclosed GCP amount; UNKNOWN when the RHP shows [●]

gcp_legal_max.formula: 25% of the Fresh Offer, recorded separately from the disclosed amount

peer_status.VALID: peer multiple sourced and within peer_staleness_days of the evaluation date, business comparable, and listed at least peer_min_listed_years
peer_status.UNUSABLE: peer listed for less than peer_min_listed_years or business model materially mismatched
peer_status.rule: CORRECTED IN v1.5: only VALID peers may produce a valuation score. STALE / UNUSABLE / MISSING peers make the dependent valuation criterion UNKNOWN, which widens the score range. Stale data is never scored as current, and is never silently scored as zero either.
